_comment: Copy to RAS-CPF-OLVM-Settings.json next to OLVM-CustomProvider-LinkedClone.ps1. Credentials remain in Parallels RAS provider settings, never in this file.

data_directory.description: Directory for provider log and persistent state.

log_file.description: Log filename, relative to data_directory unless absolute.

template_state_file.description: Persistent RAS template flags for source VMs.

linked_template_state_file.description: Maps RAS template versions to immutable OLVM templates used by linked clones.

tasks_polling_rate.description: Seconds between RAS asynchronous task polls.

tasks_polling_retries.description: Allows up to 30 minutes at the default five-second polling rate.

template_method.description: RAS versions use named snapshots plus immutable OLVM templates.

can_link_clones.description: Advertise thin copy-on-write clones backed by immutable OLVM templates.

max_age_minutes.description: Hard ceiling for clone, snapshot, and template tasks.

persist_memory.description: Must remain false for Windows 11 VMs with virtual TPM.

excluded_vm_names.description: VM names hidden from RAS inventory.
